nodes.description: Governance address state variable of MochiEngine; controls every onlyGov setter.
Operation wallet address, initialized to the deployer msg.sender.
Immutable reference to the MochiVaultFactory created in the constructor.
Constructor that stores governance, deploys MochiVaultFactory and sets operationWallet = msg.sender.
onlyGov setter that overwrites governance with an arbitrary address.
onlyGov setter that overwrites operationWallet.
Representative onlyGov protocol setter (changeMochi); same pattern as all other change* functions.
Deployer controlled msg.sender in the constructor, assigned to operationWallet.
Caller controlled msg.sender compared against governance in the onlyGov modifier.
Immutable MochiEngine reference used by the factory for governance checks.
Immutable Beacon instance that holds the vault template implementation.
Cached template address of the vault implementation.
Governance-only template updater; performs an unchecked low-level call to the Beacon.
Deploys a beacon proxy vault with initialize(address) init calldata via CREATE2.
View helper that computes the deterministic vault address.
Low-level address(beacon).call(abi.encode(_newTemplate)) whose success flag is ignored; writes storage slot 0 of the Beacon.
Assembly fallback: returns sload(0) to non-controllers and sstore(0, calldataload(0)) when called by the controller.
Beacon storage slot 0 holding the implementation/template address.
Immutable controller address allowed to overwrite the implementation slot.
CREATE2 deployer constructor that staticcalls the beacon, delegatecalls the template and returns minimal proxy runtime code.
Delegatecall to the template obtained from the beacon using caller-supplied initialization calldata.
onlyMinter mint entrypoint that increases total supply and credits a recipient.
Burns USDM from msg.sender.
ERC3156 flash loan: mints to receiver, calls onFlashLoan callback, then burns and transfers fee to treasury.
Immutable MochiEngine reference used for minter and treasury lookups.
Total supply modified by _mint and _burn.
Balance mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Internal transfer using unchecked balance subtraction guarded by a require.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal burn that decreases balance and _totalSupply.
Allowance based transfer with unchecked allowance decrement after a require.
Returns type(uint256).max - totalSupply().
Computes the flash fee as amount * 0.1337% using scaled integer arithmetic.
External call to attacker-supplied _receiver.onFlashLoan executed before the loan principal is burned.
Multiplications/divisions in flashFee and maxFlashLoan on user-controlled amounts.
MOCHI token address controlled by the onlyGov setters.
Treasury address receiving flash loan fees.
Minter address checked by USDM.onlyMinter.
Constructor argument for the initial governance address.
Attacker-influenced template address ABI-encoded into the low-level Beacon call.
Asset address embedded into the vault initialization calldata.
Untrusted flash loan receiver contract that is called back.
Loan token address, required to equal address(this).
Loan amount used for minting, fee calculation and burning.
Arbitrary attacker-controlled calldata forwarded to the receiver.
Local computed flash loan fee.
ABI-encoded initialize(address) calldata used for the proxy deployment.
Hardcoded CREATE2 salt (bytes32(0)).
Concatenated creation code passed to CREATE2.
Template address decoded from the beacon staticcall and delegatecalled.
EIP-1167 style beacon proxy runtime bytecode returned on deployment.

edges.reason: _governance parameter is stored by the constructor.
Constructor writes governance.
Constructor initializes operationWallet.
Deployer msg.sender becomes the privileged operationWallet.
msg.sender flows into constructor initialization logic.
Constructor deploys and stores the vault factory.
onlyGov gates changeGovernance.
onlyGov gates changeOperationWallet.
onlyGov gates changeMochi.
changeGovernance rewrites the governance state variable.
changeOperationWallet rewrites the operation wallet.
changeMochi rewrites the MOCHI token address.
updateTemplate authorizes via engine.governance().
msg.sender must equal engine.governance() to pass updateTemplate.
updateTemplate stores the new template address.
updateTemplate performs the unchecked low-level Beacon call.
Beacon fallback sstore writes the implementation slot from calldata.
Non-controller callers are routed to the read branch of the Beacon fallback.
_CONTROLLER identity decides which Beacon fallback branch executes.
Assembly in the fallback reads/writes storage slot 0.
_asset is encoded into the vault initialization calldata.
deployVault builds initCode for initialize(address).
deployVault triggers the CREATE2 maker constructor through the deployer library.
createCode is the init code executed for the new proxy.
Constructor returns the minimal proxy runtime code.
Constructor delegatecalls the template with the initialization calldata.
Template address obtained from the beacon targets the delegatecall.
Fixed salt determines the deterministic vault address produced by deployVault.
mint delegates to ERC20._mint.
onlyMinter compares msg.sender with engine.minter().
The engine minter state variable authorizes minting.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
_mint increases total supply.
burn delegates to ERC20._burn.
_burn debits the account balance.
_burn decreases total supply.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
_transfer mutates balances with unchecked subtraction.
flashLoan mints the principal to the receiver.
flashLoan calls the untrusted receiver callback.
Attacker-controlled receiver is the callback target.
Loan amount is passed into the callback.
Arbitrary data is forwarded into the callback.
State-changing burn of the principal happens only after the external callback returns.
Token address is validated inside flashLoan.
Loan amount drives mint/burn accounting in flashLoan.
User-provided amount is added to total supply.
Computed fee is used for the treasury transfer.
Fee originates from flashFee math.
flashFee performs scaled multiplication on the amount.
maxFlashLoan subtracts totalSupply from uint256 max.
flashLoan burns the principal from the receiver after the callback.
flashLoan transfers the fee using _transfer.
flashLoan reads engine.treasury() for the fee destination.
Flash loan fees are sent to the engine treasury address.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the constructor state initialization.
Template argument exists only to update the factory template.
Asset argument is only used to bootstrap a vault proxy.
Receiver is the direct target of the untrusted flash loan callback.
Token argument only participates in the flashLoan validation.
Amount argument drives mint/burn accounting inside flashLoan.
Data argument is only forwarded through flashLoan.
Local fee value is confined to the flashLoan execution.
Init code is only built and used inside deployVault.
Hardcoded salt only affects the CREATE2 vault deployment performed by deployVault.
Creation code is the init code consumed by the CREATE2 maker constructor.
Decoded template address is the direct delegatecall target.
Runtime code is produced and returned only by the constructor.
